summary: Cellectis S.A., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report and does not announce any special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or capital return. The document incorporates forward-looking statements and notes the financial statements are prepared under IAS 34. As a standard earnings release with no transactional details, changes in control, or extraordinary corporate actions, it does not trigger a special-situation classification.
